Use separate edited frames when a sprite grid distorts the character too much.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A character image; image editing and GIF assembly tools.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Create nine separate variations of the supplied character image for a gentle animation. Change the pose only slightly between frames. Keep the character’s size, position, identity, and background consistent.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Inspect and align the frames, then assemble them into a looping GIF. If the motion needs more in-between frames, create another set using the same references.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-separate-frame-animation?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--separate-frame-animation)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- Editorial workflow adaptation. The creator reports using two sets of nine separate variations after a 3-by-3 sheet changed the design too much.
- The original base image was made with Nano Banana Pro; GPT Image 2.5 was used for subsequent edits.

精灵表导致角色变形时，改用独立编辑的差分帧。

**编辑改写 · 多步骤工作流 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 角色图；图像编辑与 GIF 组装工具。

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>

#### 步骤 1

```text
基于提供的角色图，创建九张独立差分图用于轻柔动画。每帧只轻微改变姿势，保持角色大小、位置、身份和背景一致。
```

#### 步骤 2

```text
检查并对齐各帧，再组装循环 GIF。若需要更多中间帧，使用相同参考再生成一组。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

按顺序执行步骤，按要求复用先前结果，开始前确认外部处理工具可用。

### 使用说明

- 这是工作流编辑改写。作者报告 3×3 精灵表导致设计变化过大，随后改为两组各九张独立差分图。
- 原始底图由 Nano Banana Pro 制作，后续编辑使用 GPT Image 2.5。
